rows.english: Put plants planted together in one group. Keep older and younger plants separate. Dates and expected kg stay on this device with your picking months.
rows.zu: Hlanganisa izitshalo ezatshalwa ngesikhathi esisodwa eqenjini elilodwa. Hlukanisa ezindala nezincane. Izinsuku nama-kg alindelwe kugcinwa kule divayisi kanye nezinyanga zakho zokuvuna.
rows.st: Beha dimela tse jetsweng ka nako e le nngwe sehlopheng se le seng. Arola dimela tsa kgale le tse nyane. Matsatsi le kg tse lebeletsweng di dula sesebedisweng sena le dikgwedi tsa hao tsa kotulo.
rows.ts: Veka swimila leswi byariweke hi nkarhi wun’we eka ntlawa wun’we. Hambanisa swa khale ni leswitsongo. Masiku ni kg leti languteriweke swi hlayisiwa eka xitirhisiwa lexi ni tin’hweti ta wena to tshovela.
rows.ve: Vheani zwimela zwo ṱavhiwaho nga tshifhinga tshithihi kha tshigwada tshithihi. Fhambanyani zwa kale na zwiṱuku. Maḓuvha na kg dzo lavhelelwaho zwi dzula kha tshishumiswa itshi na miṅwedzi yaṋu ya khaṋo.

rows.st: Ha ho mohlodi wa dilemo tsa kotulo ya pele. Kenya lenaneo la chai le hlahlobilweng sebakeng sena.
rows.ts: Malembe ya ntshovelo wo sungula a ma na xihlovo. Engetela nongonoko wa ntshovelo lowu kambisisiweke laha kaya.
rows.ve: A hu na tshiko tsha miṅwaha ya khaṋo ya u thoma. Engedzani mbekanyamushumo ya khaṋo yo ṱolwaho henefho.

rows.zu: Hlola uhlobo, izithombo, indawo namayunithi ngaphambi kokusebenzisa umthombo. Uhlelo lwama-kg olufakile lusetshenziselwa ukubala isibikezelo.
rows.st: Hlahloba mofuta, dimela tsa ho jala, sebaka le diyuniti pele o sebedisa tshupiso. Lenaneo la kg leo o le kentseng le fana ka dipalo tsa ponelopele.
rows.ts: Kambisisa muxaka, swimilana swo byala, ndhawu ni tiyuniti u nga si tirhisa xihlovo. Nongonoko wa kg lowu u wu ngheniseke hi wona wu nyikaka tinhlayo ta mvhumbo.
rows.ve: Ṱolani lushaka, zwimela zwa u ṱavha, fhethu na yuniti musi ni sa athu u shumisa tshiko. Mbekanyamushumo ya kg ye na dzhenisa i yone ine ya ṋea mbalo dza mbonelaphanḓa.

rows.english: Expected harvest per plant in a year at each age. Use your records or a nursery's advice for this site. A value holds until the next age you enter; change it if older plants produce less.
rows.zu: Isivuno esilindelwe esitshalweni ngasinye ngonyaka eminyakeni ngayinye. Sebenzisa amarekhodi akho noma iseluleko senkulisa yezitshalo ngale ndawo. Inani lisebenza kuze kube yiminyaka elandelayo oyifakayo; lishintshe uma izitshalo ezindala zikhiqiza kancane.
rows.st: Kotulo e lebeletsweng semeleng ka seng ka selemo dilemong ka ding. Sebedisa direkoto tsa hao kapa keletso ya sebaka sa dipeo bakeng sa sebaka sena. Palo e sebetsa ho fihlela dilemong tse latelang tseo o di kenyang; e fetole haeba dimela tsa kgale di hlahisa hanyane.
rows.ts: Ntshovelo lowu languteriweke eka ximilana xin’wana ni xin’wana hi lembe eka malembe man’wana ni man’wana ya xona. Tirhisa tirhekhodo ta wena kumbe switsundzuxo swa ndhawu yo kurisa swimilana swa ndhawu leyi. Nhlayo yi tirha ku fika eka malembe lama landzelaka lama u ma nghenisaka; yi cinca loko swimila swa khale swi humesa switsongo.
rows.ve: Khaṋo yo lavhelelwaho kha tshimela tshiṅwe na tshiṅwe nga ṅwaha kha miṅwaha yatsho yo fhambanaho. Shumisani rekhodo dzaṋu kana nyeletshedzo ya fhethu ha u alusa zwimela nga ha fhethu afha. Mbalo i shuma u swika kha miṅwaha i tevhelaho ine na i dzhenisa; i shanduleni arali zwimela zwa kale zwi tshi bveledza zwiṱuku.

rows.english: Picking months vary by place and variety. Outlined calendar marks are planning references when established. Confirm months for plants that already give food here to count them in food totals. Plants stay on the printed plan while dates are unknown.
rows.zu: Izinyanga zokuvuna ziyahlukahluka ngendawo nohlobo. Izimpawu ezinohlaka ekhalendeni ziyimithombo yokuhlela uma izitshalo sezikhulile. Qinisekisa izinyanga zezitshalo esezivele zinikeza ukudla lapha ukuze zibalwe esambeni sokudla. Izitshalo zihlala ohlelweni oluphrintiwe ngisho izinsuku zingakaziwa.
rows.st: Dikgwedi tsa kotulo di fapana ka sebaka le mofuta. Matshwao a nang le moedi khalendareng ke ditshupiso tsa ho rera ha dimela di hodile. Netefatsa dikgwedi tsa dimela tse seng di fana ka dijo mona hore di balwe palong yohle ya dijo. Dimela di sala moralong o hatisitsweng ha matsatsi a sa tsejwe.
rows.ts: Tin’hweti to tshovela ti hambana hi ndhawu ni muxaka. Mimfungho ya khalendara leyi nga ni ndzilakano i swihlovo swo kunguhata loko swimila swi kurile. Tiyisisa tin’hweti ta swimila leswi se swi nyikaka swakudya laha leswaku swi hlayiwa eka ntsengo wa swakudya. Swimila swi sala eka pulani leyi kandziyisiweke loko masiku ma nga si tiveka.
rows.ve: Miṅwedzi ya khaṋo i fhambana nga fhethu na lushaka. Maswayo a khaḽenda a re na mikano ndi zwiko zwa u dzudzanya musi zwimela zwo no aluwa. Khwaṱhisedzani miṅwedzi ya zwimela zwine zwa khou ṋea zwiḽiwa afha uri zwi vhalelwe kha ṱhanganyelo ya zwiḽiwa. Zwimela zwi dzula kha pulani yo gandiswaho musi maḓuvha a sa athu u ḓivhea.

rows.english: Kept as mapped inventory. Check the sourced food-use guidance below before planning household harvest. This plant is held out of ordinary food totals and picking jobs.
rows.zu: Sigcinwa ohlwini lwezitshalo ezisebalazweni. Hlola iziqondiso zokusetshenziswa njengokudla ezinomthombo ngezansi ngaphambi kokuhlela isivuno sasekhaya. Lesi sitshalo asibalwa ezambeni ezivamile zokudla nasemisebenzini yokuvuna.
rows.st: Se bolokwa lenaneng la tse mmapeng. Hlahloba tataiso ya mohlodi ya tshebediso e le dijo ka tlase pele o rera kotulo ya lelapa. Semela sena ha se kenyelletswe dipalong tse tlwaelehileng tsa dijo le mesebetsing ya kotulo.
rows.ts: Xi hlayisiwa eka nxaxamelo wa leswi nga eka mepe. Kambisisa nkongomiso lowu nga ni xihlovo wa ku tirhisiwa tani hi swakudya laha hansi u nga si kunguhata ntshovelo wa le kaya. Ximilana lexi a xi hlayiwi eka mitsengo ya ntolovelo ya swakudya ni mintirho yo tshovela.
rows.ve: Tshi vhulungwa kha mutevhe wa zwi re kha mapa. Ṱolani nyeletshedzo i re na tshiko ya u shumiswa sa zwiḽiwa afho fhasi musi ni sa athu u dzudzanya khaṋo ya muṱa. Tshimela itshi a tshi vhalelwi kha ṱhanganyelo dzo ḓoweleaho dza zwiḽiwa na mishumo ya khaṋo.

rows.english: Bars use a labelled variety assumption or regional reference. New plants need time to produce. Only locally confirmed months enter your food totals.
rows.zu: Amabha asebenzisa ukucatshangwa kohlobo olubhalwe ngokucacile noma umthombo wesifunda. Izitshalo ezintsha zidinga isikhathi ngaphambi kokukhiqiza. Izinyanga eziqinisekiswe endaweni kuphela ezibalwa ezambeni zakho zokudla.
rows.st: Meballo e sebedisa kgakanyo ya mofuta e ngotsweng kapa tshupiso ya lebatowa. Dimela tse ntjha di hloka nako pele di hlahisa. Ke dikgwedi tse netefaditsweng sebakeng sena feela tse kenang dipalong tsohle tsa dijo tsa hao.
rows.ts: Mibara yi tirhisa ku ringanyeta ka muxaka loku tsariweke kumbe xihlovo xa xifundzha. Swimila leswintshwa swi lava nkarhi leswaku swi humesa ntshovelo. I tin’hweti leti tiyisisiweke laha kaya ntsena leti nghenaka eka mitsengo ya swakudya swa wena.
rows.ve: Mabari a shumisa khumbulelo ya lushaka yo ṅwalwaho kana tshiko tsha dzingu. Zwimela zwiswa zwi ṱoḓa tshifhinga u bveledza. Ndi miṅwedzi yo khwaṱhisedzwaho henefho fhedzi ine ya dzheniswa kha ṱhanganyelo dzaṋu dza zwiḽiwa.

rows.english: Research groupings can infer climate fit. Confirm the season, soil, water and current stock with a local grower or extension officer. A recorded variety does not change this plan’s crop timing.
rows.zu: Ukuhlukaniswa ngamaqembu ocwaningweni kungasiza ukucabangela ukufaneleka kwesimo sezulu. Qinisekisa isikhathi, inhlabathi, amanzi nezithombo ezitholakalayo nomlimi wendawo noma isikhulu sezolimo. Uhlobo olurekhodiwe alushintshi izikhathi zokutshala nokuvuna zalolu hlelo.
rows.st: Dihlopha tsa dipatlisiso di ka fana ka kgakanyo ya ho tshwaneleha ha tlelaemete. Netefatsa sehla, mobu, metsi le dimela tse fumanehang hona jwale le molemi wa lehae kapa ofisiri ya katoloso ya temo. Mofuta o rekotilweng ha o fetole dinako tsa dijalo tsa moralo ona.
rows.ts: Mintlawa ya ndzavisiso yi nga pfuna ku ringanyeta ku faneleka ka maxelo. Tiyisisa nguva, misava, mati ni swimilana leswi kumekaka sweswi ni murimi wa laha kaya kumbe muofisiri wa switsundzuxo swa vurimi. Muxaka lowu rhekhodiweke a wu cinci minkarhi ya swibyariwa ya pulani leyi.
rows.ve: Zwigwada zwa ṱhoḓisiso zwi nga thusa u humbulela u tea ha kilima. Khwaṱhisedzani tshifhinga, mavu, maḓi na zwimela zwi re hone zwino na mulimi wa henefho kana muofisiri wa nyeletshedzo ya vhulimi. Lushaka lwo rekhodiwaho a lu shanduli zwifhinga zwa zwiliṅwa zwa pulani iyi.

rows.english: Past production recorded in your survey
rows.st: Tlhahiso ya nakong e fetileng e rekotilweng tlhahlobong ya hao
rows.ts: Vuhumelerisi bya khale byi rhekhodiweke eka nkambisiso wa wena
rows.ve: Vhubveledzi ha tshifhingani tsho fhiraho ho rekhodiwaho kha ṱhoḓisiso yaṋu

rows.english: Use these records to compare with what you actually collect. They do not predict the coming year or set picking dates.
rows.zu: Sebenzisa la marekhodi ukuqhathanisa nalokho okuvuna ngempela. Awabikezeli unyaka ozayo futhi awabeki izinsuku zokuvuna.
rows.st: Sebedisa direkoto tsena ho bapisa le seo o se bokellang ka nnete. Ha di bolele esale pele selemo se tlang kapa ho beha matsatsi a kotulo.
rows.ts: Tirhisa tirhekhodo leti ku pimanisa ni leswi u swi hlengeletaka hakunene. A ti vhumbhi lembe leri taka kumbe ku veka masiku yo tshovela.
rows.ve: Shumisani rekhodo idzi u vhambedza na zwine na zwi kuvhanganya zwa vhukuma. A dzi bvumbi ṅwaha u ḓaho kana u vhea maḓuvha a khaṋo.

rows.english: Tree and harvest translations are unreviewed drafts. Some source references remain in English.
rows.zu: Izinguqulo zezihlahla nesivuno ziyimibhalo engakabuyekezwa. Eminye imithombo isesiNgisini.
rows.st: Diphetolelo tsa difate le kotulo ke dingolwa tse eso hlahlojwe. Ditshupiso tse ding tsa mohlodi di ntse di le ka Senyesemane.
rows.ts: Vuhundzuluxeri bya misinya ni ntshovelo i matsalelo lama nga si kambisisiwaka. Swihlovo swin’wana swa ha ri hi Xinghezi.
rows.ve: Ṱhalutshedzelo dza miri na khaṋo ndi mvetamveto i sa athu u ṱolisiswa. Zwiṅwe zwiko zwi kha ḓi vha nga Luisimane.
